title: sebaro share-image page list 1.0
description: Input of brand/og/render.mjs (spec/09 §18.1, D96): one entry per page that has a title of its own. The script validates a page list against this file itself (the keywords it reads: type, required, properties, additionalProperties, enum, pattern, minLength, maxLength, minimum, maximum, items, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems, $ref), so the schema is the one definition of the format. Words are the page's own: the image says nothing the page does not say.

product.description: The site's product id (its tile and name in the head); a page may name another.

name.description: og:site_name: the site's name as it writes it.

origin.description: Scheme and host without a trailing slash, e.g. https://example.org; og:url, og:image and canonical are absolute from it, and its host ends the meta line.

lang.description: Language of the words the script adds (reading time, date) and of og:locale (de_DE, en_GB). Default de. Right to left is not supported.

imageBase.description: Path under origin where the site serves the PNGs, with slashes at both ends. Default /og/.

product.description: A product id with brand/inline/tile-<id>.svg in the export (export with --product <id>; the umbrella product studio exports every tile).

id.description: Unique id of the page; the file name of its image unless output is set.

url.description: The page's path under origin, e.g. /phase-5/state/; canonical and og:url.

title.description: The page's own title (its h1, the <title> without „ · sebaro“). At most three lines fit; a longer title fails with the page id, it is never cut or set smaller. Mark break points in long compounds with U+00AD (soft hyphen); the template breaks only there and at spaces.

path.description: The page's breadcrumb steps as the page shows them, e.g. [„<site name>“, „<section>“, „<page>“]; drawn with the chevron icon between them (D82). One line; a longer path fails.

readingMinutes.description: Reading time the page states: „12 Min. Lesezeit“ (de), „12 min read“ (en).

date.description: ISO date the page states; rendered „26.04.2026“ (de) or „2026-04-26“ (en), spec/07 §3 item 5.

dateKind.description: Word before the date: „aktualisiert am“ / „veröffentlicht am“ (de), „updated“ / „published“ (en). Default updated.

product.description: Product of this page if it is not site.product.

output.description: File name without .png; default id. Unique in the list.

description.description: The page's own description: meta description and og:description. Never drawn into the image.

type.description: og:type; default article, website for the start page.

alt.description: og:image:alt; default „<product name>: <title>“, with apps followed by the sentence naming their signs.

apps.description: App signs with their names in the foot, for a page that lists those apps (the studio start page). One line; too many fail.
